static_traits.name: Li Wei
static_traits.social_status: Reducing contact with newly met people for fear of being judged, social participation limited
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no prior psychological counseling/treatment
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with good logic, able to self-reflect and highly cooperative, neutral tone

basic_info.main_problem: I worry a future partner will think I am a 'nerd/loser' because of interests like anime, leading to inferiority and fear of rejection, which affects my confidence in pursuing intimate relationships and my social participation.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to reduce worry about being judged for their interests, improve self-esteem and confidence, and develop intimate relationships more naturally; learn to identify and challenge negative thinking such as catastrophizing and jumping to conclusions, and rebuild more balanced cognitions.
growth_experiences: Long exposed to societal stereotypes of anime fans as 'childish / nerdy / losers', and gradually internalized them as a negative reference for evaluating self and others.

core_beliefs: I am a failure (nerds are unpopular)

special_situations.event: A friend proposes introducing a blind date partner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I reveal my love of anime, a potential partner will think I am childish / a failure and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids blind dates and socializing; hides interests to avoid evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She will think I am strange and childish

special_situations.event: Thinking about future romance and meeting new friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person cannot understand or appreciate my interests, we cannot possibly build a relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces self-disclosure and lowers contact frequency for self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She will not understand me and will definitely reject me in the end

special_situations.event: Encountering society's negative stereotypes about anime fans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If most people think anime is childish, then potential partners will think so too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or weakening related interests in social situations to avoid being labeled
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone thinks anime is childish, so she will see me that way too

special_situations.event: Preparing to interact with others in social situations or being introduced to new people by friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my interest is known, it will bring negative evaluation and bad consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowering or concealing interest in advance, choosing not to meet to avoid the worst case
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once it is known that I like anime, things will be bad

core_conflict.wish: Authentically expressing one's interests in an intimate relationship and being accepted/understood
core_conflict.fear: Encountering humiliation and rejection because the true self is seen as childish or a failure
defense_goal: Avoiding the possibility of being rejected by maintaining distance and reducing self-disclosure
Explains based on social stereotypes, reducing inner anxiety and uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: A 'nerd/failure' who may be belittled and not understood
object_relations.object_representation: A critical, contemptuous, and prejudiced potential partner/other

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is understood and accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Close friends with acceptance and similar interests

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether there are positive reactions from others, or invited to consider different possibilities (for example, that someone might accept his interests)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes 'most people view anime negatively', inferring from this that the probability of being accepted is very low
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Based on the view that 'most people are like this', with an objective tone and generalized descriptions, weakening personal emotional experience and avoiding deeply touching shame and fear.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores their emotional experience or invites them to notice inner shame and fear
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Shifting attention to discussion of concepts and social evaluation, to reduce emotional involvement
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a tone of rational analysis, uses generalized wording, and reduces the exposure of emotional vocabulary and subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling scenes of potential blind dates or needing to self-expose interests
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Converts possible external negative evaluations into self-evaluation (feeling oneself childish / a failure)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses self-negating and self-blaming expressions, with a restrained tone, lowering expectations of others to maintain a safe distance.

manifestations: Worries true interests will not be accepted and avoids intimate contact
Hiding oneself before potential intimate relationships to avoid being rejected
outcomes: Sleep and daily rhythms are affected

manifestations: Wavers between 'genuinely expressing interests' and 'catering to social expectations / avoiding evaluation'
Suppressing expression of one's own interests to gain approval
outcomes: Long-term caution and self-restriction reduce authenticity in relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes the stereotype that 'most people think anime is childish / nerdy' as Gourund, thereby restricting self-expression
In expectations of intimate relationships, replacing self-assessment with outside evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In social settings, deliberately downplaying interests and being cautious about self-exposure
Highly sensitive to possible negative evaluation, thus avoiding blind dates or contact in new relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presuming without contact that 'she will think I am childish/strange'
Attributing inner shame and unease to others' possible evaluations

exception_events.target_problem: When facing newly acquainted people or potential partners, the client usually avoids contact or hides interests for fear of being judged, resulting in missed opportunities to build relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In interaction with a like-minded close friend, the client frankly expressed a love of anime, and the other person fully accepted it; in this relationship, the client felt understood, more relaxed, and more confident.
exception_events.reason: Different support: a close friend shares similar interests and an accepting attitude; different context: a non-judgmental, safe relationship; different approach: able to express the self more authentically.

positive_force: There is a close friendship with someone accepting who can provide emotional support
Stable work and clear technical expertise, good professional self-efficacy
Having self-reflection ability, willing to try small-scale behavioral experiments
Able to recognize thinking such as catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions and willing to practice restructuring
negative_force: Internalizing social stereotypes, over-relying on external evaluation to judge self-worth
Marked cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions (mind reading / fortune-telling), and overgeneralization
High sensitivity to rejection and shame leads to social avoidance and self-suppression
Changing daily routine and sleep due to worry, forming a negative feedback cycle

antecedent: Thinking about interacting with new people or starting a potential romance
A friend proposes arranging a blind date/introducing a potential partner
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears being rejected because the interest is seen as childish / a failure; after internalizing the stereotype, catastrophically anticipates shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping the potential risk of rejection and shame, gaining a short-term sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Misses opportunities to build relationships, maintaining negative beliefs and self-doubt; anxiety persists and affects routine and sleep

target_behavior.behavior: In social settings, deliberately hides or downplays personal interests (anime, electronic music)
antecedent: Social situations of chatting with others, meeting for the first time, or possibly being evaluated
Becoming alert and uneasy about self-disclosure
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries that once the interest is exposed, they will be labeled 'childish / nerdy' and subsequently negated
target_behavior.function: Reduces immediate anxiety about being judged and maintains surface harmony in relationships
target_behavior.consequence: Self-consistency declines, making it hard to build genuine and intimate connections, reinforcing distrust of self and others
